A few practical questions

Where do I start if I know AI could help but don’t know how?

Start with one task that takes too long: copying job details, preparing reports or sorting enquiries. Show me how it works today. I’ll help you work out whether AI, a connection between systems or a small custom tool is a practical fit.

Do I have to replace my existing software?

No. Connecting the software you already use may solve the problem. A custom app is an option when the current setup keeps forcing your team into workarounds.

What will it cost?

The systems involved, the scope of the change and ongoing support determine the cost. We agree the work and its cost before starting. The guide to AI consulting costs explains what to compare.

Can we meet in Melbourne?

Yes. I’m based in Melbourne and happy to meet for coffee to talk through your business. We can also start with a call. Tell me what’s taking too long.
